title: Fourier atom probability distribution
statement: For a nonzero function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, define a probability distribution on subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ by assigning mass $|\widehat f(S)|/\|\widehat f\|_1$ to $S$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient and $\|\widehat f\|_1=\sum_T|\widehat f(T)|$.
